result:
I traced the three permission gates back to the single source of truth — `ROLE_MATRIX` in `src/lib/permissions.ts` — and compared it against the documentation's claims:

- **Comments** (`ROLE_MATRIX["comment:create"] = "member"`): `docs/requirements/comments-and-mentions.md` states in its Context section that "`comment:create` carries a `viewer` minimum in `ROLE_MATRIX`, so a read-only collaborator... can still reply on a thread without being promoted to `member`." This is false — the actual minimum is `member`, so a viewer cannot comment as the doc claims.

- **Archiving a project** (`ROLE_MATRIX["project:archive"] = "admin"`): `docs/requirements/projects.md` (REQ-045) states "`project:archive` is gated at `owner` in `ROLE_MATRIX` — the same minimum as `project:delete`." This is false — the code only requires `admin`, so an admin (not just an owner) can archive a project, contradicting the documented minimum. (Note: `docs/requirements/membership-and-roles.md` REQ-024 and `docs/design/permission-model.md` DES-043 both correctly state `admin` for this action — only `projects.md` has the wrong claim.)

- **Feature-flag settings screen** (`ROLE_MATRIX["org:manage_flags"] = "admin"`): `docs/ui/screen-settings-billing-flags-webhooks.md` (SCR-022) states "Permission required: `org:manage_flags` (member and above) — 404 otherwise." This is false — the actual minimum is `admin`, not `member`.

ANSWER: docs/requirements/comments-and-mentions.md, docs/requirements/projects.md, docs/ui/screen-settings-billing-flags-webhooks.md
